boundary.description: From the crossing of Prestwich – Whitefield railway and Moss Lane, S to M60 Motorway and E along the Motorway to the crossing with Egypt Lane (near Egypt Farm) and by a beeline E to the junction of Heywood Old Road and unnamed road south of Simon Lane, then by a beeline to the junction of Sheepfoot Lane (A6044) and Meade Hill Road, and W along Sheepfoot Lane and N along Bury Old Road to its junction with Ostrich Lane, Bent Lane Whittaker Lane, Rectory Lane, St Mary’s Road and then S by Bury New Road and W by Butterstile Lane, Shrewsbury Road, Lowther Road, Cawley Avenue to its junction with Grundy Avenue and by a bee-line to River Irwell. N along River Irwell, to M60 Motorway, and E along the Motorway to the point opposite Hill Crest Farm. Then by a beeline to Phillips Park Road West, Park Lane, Pinfold Lane, and Moss Lane to its crossing with Prestwich – Whitefield railway.
